concepts.summary: Fake jet sweep one way, then a toss the other way with one man cracking.
concepts.qb: Reverse pivot. Fake the jet sweep, toss to the back and sell the keeper.
concepts.hb: 7.5 yards deep. Lateral crossover run to take the toss. Stay lateral and read the force and the alley blocking on the edge.
concepts.criteria: Check it against G Bub, pressure, or a jam zone look.

positions.F: The motion man. Sells the Spirit or Alaska jet sweep.
positions.Z: Labeled Single or Thru on the cards: the crack block.
positions.Y: Labeled Speed B or Gang on the cards.

alerts: Be ready for the linebackers to slide with the motion.
Perimeter rule on the cards is 8-9 MDM.

concepts.summary: An 8 or 9 hole run that attacks the perimeter with pull and pin blocking. The playside guard and tackle are alert to pull depending on how the defense lines up.
concepts.qb: Heels at 5 yards. Kick back and hand off underneath, then sell the keeper.
concepts.hb: Line up with the inside foot on the guard's outside foot. Open and run flat through the QB's toes. Get the ball out to the numbers and read the pullers.
concepts.criteria: Not against a two-high look. Check it against any pressure.

positions.OL: Playside guard and tackle pull or pin based on alignment. The center makes a Me or You call on the cards, with a Tight Shade note and a Jam rule.
positions.Y: Shows a bubble look. Against a 6 technique he influences and blocks down. Against a 9 technique he makes a Thru call and goes through to the first defender inside, on or off the ball. Against Choke he makes a 9 call and blocks the Choke player.
positions.F: Labeled Man Over or Gain on the cards.

alerts: 9 call and block the Choke player against a Choke look.
